label: RV-EV-07
command_argv:
PYTHONPATH=src python3 - <<"PY"
import importlib.util
from dataclasses import replace
from pathlib import Path
from agentic_payment_experiment import Decision, PaymentStatus
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("rv_gate_tests", Path("tests/test_webshop_runtime_gate.py"))
mod=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(mod)
case=mod.WebShopRuntimeGateTest(methodName="test_empty_known_attempt_input_preserves_prior_gate_result"); case.setUp()
unrelated_malformed=replace(case.execution,payment_id="",request_id="request-unrelated",transaction_object_ref="request-unrelated",status=PaymentStatus.SUCCEEDED)
outcome,calls=case.invoke(governed_action=case.governed_action,known_payment_attempts=(unrelated_malformed,))
print({"decision":outcome.decision.value,"callback_count":outcome.callback_count,"calls":calls,"preflight_status":outcome.known_payment_attempt_preflight_fact.status.value,"reason_codes":outcome.reason_codes})
assert outcome.decision is Decision.ALLOW, "AC-02/AC-04 violation: unrelated malformed attempt denied a legitimate current request"
assert calls == ["checkout"]
PY
